a.xlink:title: Draws one frame from the given state.
Frames the whole map: centers on it and sets the zoom so it fits with a margin.
Orbit yaw (degrees) whose horizontal forward matches a cardinal orientation.
Width of the HUD panel in pixels for a given window width.
Resolves the entity currently followed, auto-detaching if it is gone or not a player.
Enables or disables depth testing (disabled for 2D overlays like the HUD).
Sets the grid dimensions used to turn cells into torus angles.
Sets only the azimuth, leaving the elevation untouched (e.g.
Swaps the front and back buffers.
Centers the camera on a world-space point (the pan).
Stops following and recenters the orbit camera on the map center.
Currently selected entity, resolved live (null if none or it is gone).
